_comment: Default DDD conformance rules (from rules/nestjs-ddd + decision cards). Project overrides via .claude/conformance.json (kind merge).

kinds._note: majority-only (no expectExtends) — BaseEntityId is the norm, but documented ADR exceptions exist (e.g. format-validation-only IDs)
majority-only (no expectExtends) — plain VOs vs legit specialized bases like PolishIdentifier

majority-only (no expectExtends) — CQRS command-side repos typically extend BaseKyselyRepository, but read-side query/projection repos and documented one-off exceptions (no event sourcing needed) legitimately skip it

_bodyRules_comment: Rules about the BODY of a file (check.mjs --ratchet turns them into a delta against a git baseline). Scope is command/query handlers ONLY: event handlers (BullMQ retry rethrows a failure on purpose) and processors are out of scope. Waiver: the rule's exceptionMarker comment WITH a reason, or an entry in .claude/conformance.json `exceptions` (rule + file + reason).

bodyRules.message: throw in a command/query handler file (also in private helper methods)
bodyRules.hint: return Result.fail(error); a justified exception needs `// THROW-EXCEPTION: <reason>` or an entry in .claude/conformance.json

bodyRules.message: BullMQ import or @InjectQueue in a command/query handler
bodyRules.hint: enqueue through a port (Symbol + interface in application, adapter in the module/infrastructure); exception: `// QUEUE-EXCEPTION: <reason>`
